settings.text: A suede body under a full leather collar, with rolled leather handles and leather at all four corners. Open at the top, 18.5 inches across, and soft on purpose.

settings.title: Details
settings.content:
One size, 18.5" W x 18.5" H x 8" D.

The handle drop is short. It carries in the hand or over the forearm, not on the shoulder.

Construction: suede body, smooth leather collar wrapping the full top edge front and back, two rolled leather top handles, leather caps on all four base corners, antique brass fittings, and tonal saddle stitching along every leather edge. The top is open, with no closure.

settings.title: Delivery
settings.content:
Free shipping on all orders over $75. Orders under $75 ship at a flat $4.99. Once your order is placed it ships and arrives within 7 to 10 business days.

Made in limited runs. When a color sells out it can be 4 to 8 weeks before it returns.

Returns and exchanges within 30 days of delivery, on unused items in original packaging with tags attached.

settings.title: Care
settings.content:
Body: suede.
Collar, handles and corners: smooth leather.
Hardware: antique brass.

Brush the suede with a soft dry brush, following the nap. Wipe the leather with a clean dry cloth and condition it occasionally. Keep both out of prolonged moisture and direct sun. Store it stuffed so the collar keeps its line.

settings.heading: Customize Your Straw Tote
settings.intro: Add an organizer, charm, or scarf to complete your bag — all designed to match.

settings.headline: Woven Entirely by Hand
settings.body:
Watch how the Straw Tote moves through the day. The hand-woven seagrass holds a structured shape whether the bag is full or empty. The leather handles sit easily in the hand or over the arm. It's the kind of piece that draws a second look — and a question about where you found it.

A classic shape, reimagined in natural straw. Refined enough for evening, easy enough for every day.

settings.heading: Two-Year Warranty
settings.body: Every Velantra bag is built to last. If anything fails in normal use, we’ll repair or replace it.

settings.headline: Suede body, leather collar
settings.body: A full suede body under a smooth leather collar that wraps the entire top edge. Two materials, and you can feel both.

settings.headline: Antique brass, saddle stitching
settings.body: Brass fittings at the collar, the sides and all four corners. Tonal saddle stitching along every leather edge.

settings.headline: Made in limited runs
settings.body: Produced in small quantities. When a color sells out it can be weeks before it returns.

settings.headline: Open at the top
settings.body: No zip, no clasp, nothing to fight with one arm full. Drop it in and go.

settings.headline: Leather across the full width
settings.body: The collar wraps the top edge front and back, so the part that takes the most handling is the part built to take it.

settings.headline: Rolled, not folded
settings.body: Each handle is rolled into a tube and set through the collar. It holds its round in the hand.

settings.headline: Leather at all four corners
settings.body: Capped and studded at every point that touches the ground.

settings.headline: The suede, not the logo
settings.body: The same suede and the same leather work as bags at several times the price. There is no name stamped across the front of this one, and no markup attached to that name. You are paying for the hide and the stitching.

settings.headline: Two years covered.
settings.body: A two-year warranty on materials and construction, from the day it arrives. If stitching comes undone, a handle separates or a fitting gives out in normal use, we replace it free.
